xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4296: Fly remote: run Codex/GPT agents on remote workspaces

plan.title: Fly remote: run Codex/GPT agents on remote workspaces
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: W-FLY3's Done-when (a Codex conversation runs on a Fly VM) needs the image, provisioning, the service door, the CLI flag and the sign-in sync together; none is observable alone, and the sync is required for correctness because a copied Codex sign-in otherwise burns home's login. The surface is 20 exact files; the subsystem count is inflated because each top-level doc file (configuration/, cli/, docs/) and docker/ counts as its own subsystem. Work agents on Fly are already split to PAN-4734.

narratives.Problem: After PAN-4652 a Fly machine runs only Claude Code conversations: refuseEarly rejects codex (CODEX_CAPABILITIES.runsOnFlyMachine is false), startFlyConversation hard-codes harness claude-code, the image has no Codex CLI, nothing copies or refreshes the Codex sign-in, Claude credentials are mandatory, a codex request without a model silently becomes Claude Code, and the CLI has no --harness. A naive home-to-VM copy of ~/.codex/auth.json would fork OpenAI's rotating refresh-token family and burn whichever side refreshes second.
narratives.Proposal: Install the Codex CLI in the image; at provisioning pin the VM's Codex to home's version and push home's native sign-in to $HOME/.codex/auth.json (prepared on every machine when home can, fatal only for --harness codex); record codexAuthPath; accept harness codex in addFlyMachine with home-side checks (model required, openai provider, harness policy with home's Codex version, valid home sign-in) and pass the harness to the VM; add --harness to the CLI; add a 60 s deacon loop that syncs the sign-in both ways with newest-refresh-wins; document it; verify live with operator consent.
narratives.NonGoals:
- CLIProxy on the VM or tunnelled to home (Codex conversations call OpenAI directly)
- GPT models through the claude-code harness on Fly, and any new provider check for claude-code requests
- Other non-Claude harnesses on Fly (ohmypi, acp, kimi-code, opencode, muse) — runsOnFlyMachine stays false
- Codex for pan start --remote work agents and Codex rollout forensics/salvage (PAN-4734)
- The Machine field / --machine fly on pan start, worker run, lane start (#4651, #4638)
- Codex rules/ and user skills on the VM
- Fixing #4738, #4739, #4740, #4741 or the default image name #4682
- Changing the Claude credential refresh loop, fly-provider.ts or remote-agents.ts
- A dashboard UI for adding Fly machines
- A default model for Codex conversations

autoDecisions.summary: No CLIProxy work: Codex conversations call OpenAI directly with the Codex CLI sign-in
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex launch code has no model_provider/base_url/8317; only the claude-code harness uses CLIProxy for GPT, so the issue body's provider-routing question has no work in it (PRD D-1).

autoDecisions.summary: Prepare Codex on every Fly machine when home has the Codex CLI and a valid sign-in; fatal only for --harness codex
autoDecisions.rationale: A Claude-first machine can then take a Codex conversation later (Pull here, #4651) without re-provisioning; the extra cost is one npm install only when versions differ (D-2).

autoDecisions.summary: Sync the Codex sign-in both ways, newest last_refresh wins, every 60 s
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo already treats a forked refresh-token family as a bug (PAN-2285); a home-wins push would re-burn a VM that refreshed and a VM refresh would silently sign home out (D-3).

autoDecisions.summary: A Codex conversation needs an explicit model; refuse without one
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveAllowedHarness turns a model-less request into Claude Code, and the repo forbids hardcoded model fallbacks (D-5).

autoDecisions.summary: Check provider, harness policy and home sign-in at home before creating any VM
autoDecisions.rationale: Refusing after provisioning wastes minutes and Fly money; home's Codex version predicts the VM's because the VM is pinned to it (D-5).

autoDecisions.summary: No claude-code provider check is added
autoDecisions.rationale: It would change PAN-4652 behavior outside this issue's scope (FR-4 retired).

autoDecisions.summary: Codex sandbox on Fly is settled by the live checkpoint with a full-access fallback
autoDecisions.rationale: workspace-write uses Landlock, unverified as root in a Firecracker VM; the VM is a disposable sandbox like IS_SANDBOX=1 for Claude (D-12).

autoDecisions.summary: Pull here of a Codex Fly conversation is best effort in the checkpoint
autoDecisions.rationale: The Done-when is that a Codex conversation runs on a Fly VM; Pull here already supports codex per vault/resumable.ts, and a failure becomes a follow-up issue rather than blocking this one.

Codex auth core module: snapshot, newest-refresh-wins decision, VM read/push, atomic home write

metadata.acJustification: Six ACs: the module is a security boundary with five independent behaviors (decision, whitespace-stable comparison, VM read states, secret-free errors, atomic symlink-safe home write, home readiness) that each need their own observable check.
metadata.parallelSafeReason: It creates a new module and its new test file; no other wave-0 item touches either file.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 and D-3, D-7, D-8, D-10. New module src/lib/anywhere/fly/codex-auth.ts exporting parseCodexAuthSnapshot, decideCodexAuthSync (the five ordered rules of D-3; rule 3 compares the parsed sign-in key — tokens + last_refresh, or OPENAI_API_KEY — never raw bytes), readVmCodexAuth (D-8: `if [ -f p ]; then cat p; else printf __MISSING__; fi`, non-zero exit or thrown exec = indeterminate), pushVmCodexAuth (D-7: base64 to auth.json.tmp, chmod 600, mv -f; error message names only path and exit code), writeHomeCodexAuth (realpath when the file exists, temp file in same dir mode 0600, rename), and readHomeCodexState (resolveHarnessBinary('codex'), readCodexCliVersion via dynamic import of ../../codex/app-server-manager.js, classifyNativeCodexAuth must be 'valid'; any miss returns null; all deps injectable). Quote every path with shellQuote from src/lib/remote/remote-tmux.ts. No auth content in any log, error or detail.

items.title: Given a complete chatgpt VM snapshot with the same account_id and a strictly newer last_refresh than home, when decideCodexAuthSync runs, then it returns 'pull'; with a different account_id, an incomplete VM copy, equal last_refresh, or an api-key home it returns 'push' or 'none' per D-3, never 'pull'
Given home and VM sign-ins with the same tokens and last_refresh but different JSON whitespace, when decideCodexAuthSync runs, then it returns 'none'
Given the VM exec prints __MISSING__ with exit 0, when readVmCodexAuth runs, then it returns state 'missing'; given exit 1 or a thrown exec it returns state 'indeterminate'
Given pushVmCodexAuth's exec exits non-zero, when it rejects, then the error message contains the path and exit code and does not contain the base64 payload or any token text

Given ~/.codex/auth.json is a symlink in a temp dir, when writeHomeCodexAuth writes new content, then the symlink still points at its target, the target holds the new content, and the target's mode is 0600
Given a native auth file classified 'expired' or no codex binary, when readHomeCodexState runs, then it returns null
Provisioning prepares Codex (version pin + sign-in push) and requires only the requested harness's credentials

metadata.parallelSafeReason: After wi3 lands it edits only provision.ts, codex-auth.ts and their tests; wi7 (same wave) touches fly-machine-loops.ts and hygiene-scheduler.ts only.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. provisionFlyMachine input gains harness?: 'claude-code' | 'codex' (default claude-code); FlyProvisionDeps gains homeCodex (default readHomeCodexState); FlyProvisionResult gains codexAuthPath. Step 6: credentials-failed on missing Claude only when harness is claude-code, else log. New step 6b after configureClaudeCode calls prepareFlyCodex (added to codex-auth.ts): home null => credentials-failed for codex / log+null otherwise; probe `printf %s "$HOME/.codex"` and collapse // to /, must start with /; compare parseCodexCliVersion of VM `codex --version` with home version, install `@openai/codex@<home>` detached via detached() and poll with pollUntil(INSTALL_POLL) on /tmp/codex-install.exit, re-check; remaining mismatch => version-mismatch for codex / log+null otherwise; pushVmCodexAuth to <dir>/auth.json (failure => credentials-failed for codex / log+null). Return codexAuthPath. Never use run() for the Codex read/push (it puts stdout in errors). Update the module header step list. Existing tests get homeCodex: async () => null in the harness defaults.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Set CODEX_CAPABILITIES.runsOnFlyMachine true and update the field comment. In refuseEarly after the capability check (refusal text: 'Fly machines run Claude Code and Codex conversations; <harness> is not supported.'): codex without model => bad-request naming --model; codex with a non-openai model (getProviderForModel) => harness-unsupported; codex policy via new dep checkCodexPolicy (default: getProviderAuthMode + resolveCodexPolicyContext + canUseHarness, dynamic imports) denied => harness-unsupported with its reason; codex with homeCodex() null => credentials-failed. Claude Code requests get no new check. Pass harness into deps.provision; provisional record codexAuthPath null; patch codexAuthPath: vm.codexAuthPath with docker. startFlyConversation body sends harness: input.harness ?? 'claude-code'. Update the module header.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9. Ask the operator once (self-contained AskUserQuestion) and `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator "PAN-4296 live Fly checkpoint waiting for operator consent"` before spending Fly money. Build and push a test image with the branch's npm-packed @overdeck/core installed (PAN-4652 recipe); always pass --image (default image is broken, #4682). Run a test home dashboard from this branch's dist with its own OVERDECK_HOME and port. Run add-fly --harness codex --model <allowed openai id> --project overdeck --message 'List the top-level files and stop.'. Observe O1 (linked row with fly-<id> chip and Codex harness streams; Playwright screenshot in an isolated profile), O2 (Codex ran a shell command; on a sandbox error apply the D-12 fallback in provision.ts: write ${overdeckHome}/config.yaml with codex.permissionMode full-access before pan serve, add a provision test, re-run), O4 best effort Pull here (failure => file a follow-up issue), O3 unlink destroys the machine. Record results in ## Live verification (PAN-4296) at the end of docs/fly-provider.md and the sandbox outcome in the linked-machines.mdx Limits list. Declined => leave pending, say so in the PR, tell the orchestrator. Codex cannot start at all => stop, record evidence in continue.json, tell the orchestrator.
